scope: Two alternating evidence-reuse/full-computation pairs on the same build, both with fresh witnesses and timing enabled. Task totals include preparation, execution, skill saving when requested and extra archive verification. Two interruptions included per session. Probe measurements are repeated read-only computation outside task totals. Whole session totals include probes and diagnostics. Inclusive diagnostic spans overlap; do not add Java and browser clocks. Small exposed local study, not a population latency guarantee.
comparisonScope: Motion: exact sources, uncertainty, plans, full native traces, outcomes and actual observed reports after only fresh scene/object/job identifiers and scene hash normalization. Data: exact fresh CSV/mapping, verified metrics, actual cells and summaries in four states, SVG points and shipped HTML/JavaScript. Fresh artifact identifiers are independently verified by the original workflow; they are not treated as comparable content.

publishedBaseline.scope: Untouched published164 build run before and after candidate pairs; exact outcomes compared. Same original receipt and installed bytes. Different guarded implementation, not an isolated algorithm comparison.
